## Get started
[Browse Demos](https://www.incorta.com/demos) [Try Incorta](https://www.incorta.com/demo)
FAQ
What is Incorta?

Incorta is a governed data and AI platform that connects live, detailed data from systems of record to analytics, AI agents, applications, and workflows. Teams can analyze, build, and act from one trusted data foundation instead of exporting stale data into disconnected tools. What is the Incorta Smart Agent?

Incorta’s Smart Agent is a generative analytics agent grounded in your business data and context. Users can ask questions in natural language, create interactive dashboards and reports, generate files, and deploy AI applications without writing SQL or navigating complex schemas. What are Incorta AI Apps?

Incorta AI Apps are purpose-built applications teams create on live, governed enterprise data. AI Apps inherit existing access rules and can support approvals, scenario planning, and write-back — helping teams solve specific needs without adding another disconnected tool. How does Incorta govern AI and control spend?

Apps and agents built in Incorta inherit the access controls and row-level security already applied to the underlying data. Incorta also centralizes models, tooling, and infrastructure, helping IT maintain oversight and finance address fragmented AI spend. Can Incorta use different AI models?

Yes! Incorta supports multiple AI models, and administrators can configure which models are available. Teams can choose the model that fits each task while keeping the apps and assets they build in Incorta as model operations change.
